gaps.explanation: Every governmental fund column has a Budget and Actual (CASH BASIS) schedule in detail; the statement (p4) is modified accrual. Printed totals: General Fund cash 92,990,137 (p8) vs statement 97,432,568 (+4,442,431); Road Funds 23,924,852 (p10) vs 23,405,298 (-519,554); COVID American Rescue Plan Fund cash revenues collected '-' (0, p11: the federal money was received in prior years) vs GAAP 10,317,320 (+10,317,320); All Non-Major Special Revenue Funds 10,163,542 (p12) vs Non-major Funds 7,922,506 (-2,241,036). Statement 139,077,692 - schedule 127,078,531 = 11,999,161 = 4,442,431 - 519,554 + 10,317,320 - 2,241,036. No fix.

Cash-basis budget schedules vs the GAAP statement (p4). General Fund expenditures paid 84,827,551 (p9) vs 99,183,661 (+14,356,110; the cash schedule excludes bond-financed construction paid from escrow: p9 reconciliation 'Disbursements of cash from escrow account for construction (20,337,110)', plus GAAP accruals); Road Funds 47,921,924 (p10) vs 52,992,671 (+5,070,747); COVID ARPA 9,855,042 (p11) vs 10,163,022 (+307,980); Non-Major 12,756,171 (p12) vs 13,134,756 (+378,585). Statement 175,474,110 - schedule 155,360,688 = 20,113,422 = 14,356,110 + 5,070,747 + 307,980 + 378,585. No fund column missing; no fix.

Cash budget: Operating transfer in General 300,000 (p9) + Road 4,000,000 (p10) + Non-Major 4,513,262 (p12) = 8,813,262. Statement p4: General 250,000 + Road 4,000,000 + Non-major 4,513,262 = 8,763,262. The only difference is General Fund 300,000 cash vs 250,000 GAAP (-50,000); the matching 50,000 shows in transfers out (Non-Major cash 1,513,262 vs GAAP 1,463,262). A 50,000 Non-major-to-General transfer counted in the cash budget but not in the GAAP statement. No fix.

Cash budget: Operating transfer out General (8,700,000) (p9) + COVID ARPA (154,298) (p11) + Non-Major (1,513,262) (p12) = 10,367,560. Statement p4: General (8,700,000) + ARPA (154,298) + Non-major (1,463,262) = 10,317,560. Difference only in Non-major: 1,513,262 vs 1,463,262 = 50,000, the same 50,000 as in transfers in. No fix.
